samples.evidence: Executable dependency-confusion probe. A BeforeTargets ResolveAssemblyReferences/CoreCompile/Build hook uses MachineName through aliased MSBuild properties in a DownloadFile query to webhook.site. The research disclaimer does not neutralize the implemented callback.

Package advertises GDI+ bitmap APIs but installs build tasks that strip its PackageReference and PackageVersion entries, remove restore artifacts and can replace the consuming project with an unrelated Avalonia/database application. The implicit build target invokes cleanup on the consumer project. Supporting template files are inert; their parent package does not make them individually malicious.

coverage_rationale: The findings represent distinct supported claims: dependency-confusion exploitation and hostname disclosure for Paywall, and implicit build-hook trace removal for Systemm. Generic rewrite/delete capabilities remain notable. A third hostile finding was not added by repeating or promoting the same evidence.
changes: Added bounded MSBuild XML property provenance in sibling filefacts. It follows aliases, case-insensitive property names and root/target-local values without executing MSBuild or reading environment data. Unknown or conditional inputs remain opaque; comments, unrelated targets, overwrites and path/fragment-only hostname uses do not supply positive query evidence.

Added the neutral msbuild-precompile-hostname-query observation and moved the disclosed NuGet dependency-confusion finding to impersonation/depconf. Its required callback now uses parsed provenance and survives variable, endpoint, package and target renaming.
Corrected the hostname-exfiltration rule from fetched-package scope and direct SourceUrl text to archive scope and alias-aware callback provenance, retaining research disclosure and webhook evidence.

Relocated generic NuGet reference-removal and restore-cleanup API observations into neutral config-deletion and file-deletion homes. Their build-hook consumer retains the hostile trace-removal verdict; unsupported persistence mapping was removed.
Updated stale trait IDs in NuGet controls, made the unrelated KMS sample optional, and added aliased-callback and real-package mutation controls.
